WHOLE FIELD.

You run upfield automatically. Swipe or drag anywhere to cut left, right, up, down, or diagonally. Move freely left, right, up, or down the screen. Release to keep your position as the pitch scrolls. Arrow keys and W / A / S / D work too.

Defenders arrive in groups from different random directions and keep chasing you. Cut around them and pull away to leave them behind.

Gain +1 per new yard as you run forward. A close defender evaded earns +50 DODGE. Cross the end zone for +500 TOUCHDOWN and a new field. One tackle ends your run. Easy starts against red defenders. Medium starts at the faster white defense stage. Hardcore starts against the faster elite defense. Press Space or Escape to pause.
